title: The Death of Yang Guifei
synopsis: Read about the series of events that led to the end of Tang Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei’s love story.

fullText.simplified:
杨贵妃之死

    唐玄宗李隆基是一位功过分明的皇帝。一方面他励精图治，开创了唐朝灿烂文化的顶峰——开元盛世；另一方面他又沉迷美色、宠信奸臣，直接导致了大唐王朝由盛转衰。他的过，和一名女子有关，这名女子就是杨贵妃。唐玄宗和杨贵妃之间可歌可泣的爱情故事一直被世人流传至今。
    相传，痴情的唐玄宗深深爱着杨贵妃，无论杨贵妃想要什么东西，皇帝都会想办法满足她。
    杨贵妃很爱美，喜欢随时换漂亮的衣服。唐玄宗便安排了700多个最厉害的裁缝，专门给她做衣服；杨贵妃要洗澡，唐玄宗马上就在长安城外修造了一个华清池，陪着她在那儿泡温泉；杨贵妃最喜欢的水果是南方的荔枝，唐玄宗立刻派人用最快的马，翻山越岭一路不停地传送，把最新鲜的荔枝从南方带到长安。
    但是灾难就从这时悄悄埋下了伏笔。唐玄宗整天和杨贵妃谈情说爱，国家大事全部交给杨贵妃的堂兄杨国忠来处理。杨国忠很爱钱，而且没有管理国家的能力。有很多人想当官，他们就给杨国忠送钱。杨国忠收了这些人的钱，让很多没有能力的人当了官，所以老百姓的生活越来越苦。在这样的情况下，国家出现了很多问题。
    安禄山和史思明是当时的两个大官，他们带着十五万军队造反了，这场叛乱就是历史上有名的“安史之乱”。他们的借口是要捉拿杨国忠，由他们来管理国家，这样国家的问题就解决了。
    唐玄宗听说军队发生了叛乱，很生气也很害怕。他带着杨贵妃和她的家人一起离开了长安，逃往四川。在逃难途中，发生了一件大事。
    皇帝的士兵们认为，国家之所以乱套都是因为杨贵妃和她的堂兄。现在皇帝带着他们去四川，到时候国家还会由杨国忠继续管理。所以士兵们一起动手，把杨国忠杀了。
    这还不够，士兵们认为，国家出问题的根本原因在于杨贵妃。如果杨贵妃继续在皇帝身边，皇帝就没有时间管理国家。于是士兵们要求唐玄宗杀了杨贵妃，不然他们就不肯保护皇帝继续前进。
    唐玄宗眼泪汪汪，亲自为爱人求情：“杨贵妃是我最爱的妃子，我们在一起生活了十几年，她和杨国忠不一样，没有在外面干过什么坏事，你们饶了她吧！”
    士兵们坚决不答应。他们认定如果不杀了杨贵妃，就不能为普天下的老百姓解恨。可怜的杨贵妃流下了眼泪，她知道，到了现在这个时候皇帝也得听士兵的话。杨贵妃对唐玄宗说：“皇上，为了国家，我还是去死吧，您多保重！”最后杨贵妃上吊自杀了，那一年她才三十七岁。唐玄宗看着杨贵妃上吊用的白布，哭得非常伤心。
    士兵们亲眼见证了一切，这才愿意继续出发，很快就到了四川。后来的日子里，唐玄宗也不再是皇帝了，他每天都不怎么说话，也不怎么吃饭。因为没有了杨贵妃，任何事都无法让他高兴起来。
    结束了帝王生涯的唐玄宗，也永远失去了爱妃杨玉环。唐玄宗和杨贵妃的凄美爱情就这样谢幕了。
fullText.traditional:
楊貴妃之死

    唐玄宗李隆基是一位功過分明的皇帝。一方面他勵精圖治，開創了唐朝燦爛文化的頂峰——開元盛世；另一方面他又沉迷美色、寵信奸臣，直接導致了大唐王朝由盛轉衰。他的過，和一名女子有關，這名女子就是楊貴妃。唐玄宗和楊貴妃之間可歌可泣的愛情故事一直被世人流傳至今。
    相傳，癡情的唐玄宗深深愛著楊貴妃，無論楊貴妃想要什麼東西，皇帝都會想辦法滿足她。
    楊貴妃很愛美，喜歡隨時換漂亮的衣服。唐玄宗便安排了700多個最厲害的裁縫，專門給她做衣服；楊貴妃要洗澡，唐玄宗馬上就在長安城外修造了一個華清池，陪著她在那兒泡溫泉；楊貴妃最喜歡的水果是南方的荔枝，唐玄宗立刻派人用最快的馬，翻山越嶺一路不停地傳送，把最新鮮的荔枝從南方帶到長安。
    但是災難就從這時悄悄埋下了伏筆。唐玄宗整天和楊貴妃談情說愛，國家大事全部交給楊貴妃的堂兄楊國忠來處理。楊國忠很愛錢，而且沒有管理國家的能力。有很多人想當官，他們就給楊國忠送錢。楊國忠收了這些人的錢，讓很多沒有能力的人當了官，所以老百姓的生活越來越苦。在這樣的情況下，國家出現了很多問題。
    安祿山和史思明是當時的兩個大官，他們帶著十五萬軍隊造反了，這場叛亂就是歷史上有名的“安史之亂”。他們的借口是要捉拿楊國忠，由他們來管理國家，這樣國家的問題就解決了。
    唐玄宗聽說軍隊發生了叛亂，很生氣也很害怕。他帶著楊貴妃和她的家人一起離開了長安，逃往四川。在逃難途中，發生了一件大事。
    皇帝的士兵們認為，國家之所以亂套都是因為楊貴妃和她的堂兄。現在皇帝帶著他們去四川，到時候國家還會由楊國忠繼續管理。所以士兵們一起動手，把楊國忠殺了。
    這還不夠，士兵們認為，國家出問題的根本原因在於楊貴妃。如果楊貴妃繼續在皇帝身邊，皇帝就沒有時間管理國家。於是士兵們要求唐玄宗殺了楊貴妃，不然他們就不肯保護皇帝繼續前進。
    唐玄宗眼淚汪汪，親自為愛人求情：“楊貴妃是我最愛的妃子，我們在一起生活了十幾年，她和楊國忠不一樣，沒有在外面幹過什麼壞事，你們饒了她吧！”
    士兵們堅決不答應。他們認定如果不殺了楊貴妃，就不能為普天下的老百姓解恨。可憐的楊貴妃流下了眼淚，她知道，到了現在這個時候皇帝也得聽士兵的話。楊貴妃對唐玄宗說：“皇上，為了國家，我還是去死吧，您多保重！”最後楊貴妃上吊自殺了，那一年她才三十七歲。唐玄宗看著楊貴妃上吊用的白布，哭得非常傷心。
    士兵們親眼見證了一切，這才願意繼續出發，很快就到了四川。後來的日子裡，唐玄宗也不再是皇帝了，他每天都不怎麼說話，也不怎麼吃飯。因為沒有了楊貴妃，任何事都無法讓他高興起來。
    結束了帝王生涯的唐玄宗，也永遠失去了愛妃楊玉環。唐玄宗和楊貴妃的淒美愛情就這樣謝幕了。

sentences.traditional: 在逃難途中，發生了一件大事。
sentences.pinyin: zài táo nàn tú zhōng fā shēng le yí jiàn dà shì
sentences.english: He left Chang’an and fled to Sichuan, taking Yang Guifei and her family with him.
En route, something big happened.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝的士兵们认为，国家之所以乱套都是因为杨贵妃和她的堂兄。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝的士兵們認為，國家之所以亂套都是因為楊貴妃和她的堂兄。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì de shì bīng men rèn wéi guó jiā zhī suǒ yǐ luàn tào dōu shì yīn wèi yáng guì fēi hé tā de táng xiōng

sentences.simplified: 现在皇帝带着他们去四川，到时候国家还会由杨国忠继续管理。
sentences.traditional: 現在皇帝帶著他們去四川，到時候國家還會由楊國忠繼續管理。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài huáng dì dài zhe tā men qù sì chuān dào shí hòu guó jiā hái huì yóu yáng guó zhōng jì xù guǎn lǐ
sentences.english: The emperor’s soldiers believed that the reason for the country’s chaotic state was Yang Guifei and her cousin.

sentences.simplified: 所以士兵们一起动手，把杨国忠杀了。
sentences.traditional: 所以士兵們一起動手，把楊國忠殺了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ shì bīng men yì qǐ dòng shǒu bǎ yáng guó zhōng shā le
sentences.english: Now the emperor was taking them to Sichuan with him, so the country would continue to be governed by Yang Guozhong.
So, the soldiers acted together, and killed Yang Guozhong.

sentences.simplified: 这还不够，士兵们认为，国家出问题的根本原因在于杨贵妃。
sentences.traditional: 這還不夠，士兵們認為，國家出問題的根本原因在於楊貴妃。
sentences.pinyin: zhè hái bú gòu shì bīng men rèn wéi guó jiā chū wèn tí de gēn běn yuán yīn zài yú yáng guì fēi

sentences.simplified: 如果杨贵妃继续在皇帝身边，皇帝就没有时间管理国家。
sentences.traditional: 如果楊貴妃繼續在皇帝身邊，皇帝就沒有時間管理國家。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yáng guì fēi jì xù zài huáng dì shēn biān huáng dì jiù méi yǒu shí jiān guǎn lǐ guó jiā
sentences.english: This wasn’t enough. The soldiers believed that the root cause of the nation’s problems was Yang Guifei.

sentences.simplified: 于是士兵们要求唐玄宗杀了杨贵妃，
sentences.traditional: 於是士兵們要求唐玄宗殺了楊貴妃，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì shì bīng men yāo qiú táng xuán zōng shā le yáng guì fēi
sentences.english: If Yang Guifei continued to remain by the emperor’s side, the emperor wouldn’t have time to govern the country.

sentences.simplified: 不然他们就不肯保护皇帝继续前进。
sentences.traditional: 不然他們就不肯保護皇帝繼續前進。
sentences.pinyin: bù rán tā men jiù bù kěn bǎo hù huáng dì jì xù qián jìn
sentences.english: Thus, the soldiers requested Tang Emperor Xuanzong kill Yang Guifei, ..
.. or else they would refuse to protect the emperor in the future.

sentences.simplified: 唐玄宗眼泪汪汪，亲自为爱人求情：
sentences.traditional: 唐玄宗眼淚汪汪，親自為愛人求情：
sentences.pinyin: táng xuán zōng yǎn lèi wāng wāng qīn zì wèi ài ren qiú qíng

sentences.simplified: “杨贵妃是我最爱的妃子，我们在一起生活了十几年，
sentences.traditional: “楊貴妃是我最愛的妃子，我們在一起生活了十幾年，
sentences.pinyin: yáng guì fēi shì wǒ zuì ài de fēi zi wǒ men zài yì qǐ shēng huó le shí jǐ nián
sentences.english: Tang Emperor Xuanzong, with tears in his eyes, personally pleaded for his lover,

sentences.simplified: 她和杨国忠不一样，没有在外面干过什么坏事，你们饶了她吧！”
sentences.traditional: 她和楊國忠不一樣，沒有在外面幹過什麼壞事，你們饒了她吧！”
sentences.pinyin: tā hé yáng guó zhōng bù yí yàng méi yǒu zài wài miàn gàn guò shén me huài shì nǐ men ráo le tā ba
sentences.english: “Yang Guifei is my most beloved imperial concubine; we’ve lived together for over ten years.
She’s not the same as Yang Guozhong and hasn’t done any bad deeds out there. Please spare her!”

sentences.simplified: 士兵们坚决不答应。
sentences.traditional: 士兵們堅決不答應。
sentences.pinyin: shì bīng men jiān jué bù dā ying

sentences.simplified: 他们认定如果不杀了杨贵妃，
sentences.traditional: 他們認定如果不殺了楊貴妃，
sentences.pinyin: tā men rèn dìng rú guǒ bù shā le yáng guì fēi
sentences.english: The soldiers were very firm and did not agree.

sentences.simplified: 就不能为普天下的老百姓解恨。
sentences.traditional: 就不能為普天下的老百姓解恨。
sentences.pinyin: jiù bù néng wèi pǔ tiān xià de lǎo bǎi xìng jiě hèn
sentences.english: They maintained that if Yang Guifei wasn’t killed, ..

sentences.simplified: 可怜的杨贵妃流下了眼泪，
sentences.traditional: 可憐的楊貴妃流下了眼淚，
sentences.pinyin: kě lián de yáng guì fēi liú xià le yǎn lèi
sentences.english: .. then they wouldn’t be able to vent the hatred of the ordinary people throughout the world.

sentences.simplified: 她知道，到了现在这个时候皇帝也得听士兵的话。
sentences.traditional: 她知道，到了現在這個時候皇帝也得聽士兵的話。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào dào le xiàn zài zhè ge shí hou huáng dì yě děi tīng shì bīng de huà
sentences.english: The pitiful Yang Guifei had began crying.

sentences.simplified: 杨贵妃对唐玄宗说：
sentences.traditional: 楊貴妃對唐玄宗說：
sentences.pinyin: yáng guì fēi duì táng xuán zōng shuō
sentences.english: She knew that at this point even the emperor had to listen to the soldiers’ words.

sentences.simplified: “皇上，为了国家，我还是去死吧，您多保重！”
sentences.traditional: “皇上，為了國家，我還是去死吧，您多保重！”
sentences.pinyin: huáng shang wèi le guó jiā wǒ hái shi qù sǐ ba nín duō bǎo zhòng
sentences.english: Yang Guifei said to Tang Emperor Xuanzong,

sentences.simplified: 最后杨贵妃上吊自杀了，那一年她才三十七岁。
sentences.traditional: 最後楊貴妃上吊自殺了，那一年她才三十七歲。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yáng guì fēi shàng diào zì shā le nà yì nián tā cái sān shí qī suì
sentences.english: “Your Majesty, for the sake of the country, I had better go and die; take care!”

sentences.simplified: 唐玄宗看着杨贵妃上吊用的白布，哭得非常伤心。
sentences.traditional: 唐玄宗看著楊貴妃上吊用的白布，哭得非常傷心。
sentences.pinyin: táng xuán zōng kàn zhe yáng guì fēi shàng diào yòng de bái bù kū de fēi cháng shāng xīn
sentences.english: In the end Yang Guifei committed suicide by hanging. She was only thirty-seven years old.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong, looking at the white cloth Yang Guifei used to hang herself, cried his heart out.

sentences.simplified: 士兵们亲眼见证了一切，这才愿意继续出发，
sentences.traditional: 士兵們親眼見證了一切，這才願意繼續出發，
sentences.pinyin: shì bīng men qīn yǎn jiàn zhèng le yí qiè zhè cái yuàn yì jì xù chū fā

sentences.simplified: 很快就到了四川。
sentences.traditional: 很快就到了四川。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài jiù dào le sì chuān
sentences.english: The soldiers witnessed all of this with their own eyes, and only then were willing to continue on their journey.

sentences.simplified: 后来的日子里，唐玄宗也不再是皇帝了，他每天都不怎么说话，也不怎么吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 後來的日子裡，唐玄宗也不再是皇帝了，他每天都不怎麼說話，也不怎麼吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái de rì zi lǐ táng xuán zōng yě bú zài shì huáng dì le tā měi tiān dōu bù zěn me shuō huà yě bù zěn me chī fàn
sentences.english: Very soon, they arrived in Sichuan.

sentences.simplified: 因为没有了杨贵妃，任何事都无法让他高兴起来。
sentences.traditional: 因為沒有了楊貴妃，任何事都無法讓他高興起來。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi méi yǒu le yáng guì fēi rèn hé shì dōu wú fǎ ràng tā gāo xìng qǐ lái
sentences.english: In later days, Tang Emperor Xuanzong was also no longer the emperor; every day, he neither said much nor ate much.
Because he no longer had Yang Guifei, nothing was able to make him happy.

sentences.simplified: 结束了帝王生涯的唐玄宗，也永远失去了爱妃杨玉环。
sentences.traditional: 結束了帝王生涯的唐玄宗，也永遠失去了愛妃楊玉環。
sentences.pinyin: jié shù le dì wáng shēng yá de táng xuán zōng yě yǒng yuǎn shī qù le ài fēi yáng yù huán

sentences.simplified: 唐玄宗和杨贵妃的凄美爱情就这样谢幕了。
sentences.traditional: 唐玄宗和楊貴妃的淒美愛情就這樣謝幕了。
sentences.pinyin: táng xuán zōng hé yáng guì fēi de qī měi ài qíng jiù zhè yàng xiè mù le
sentences.english: Tang Emperor Xuanzong’s time as monarch ended, and he also lost forever his beloved imperial concubine Yang Yuhuan.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei’s poignant romance thus came to an end.

raw.synopsis: Read about the series of events that led to the end of Tang Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei’s love story.
sentence_translations: The Death of Yang Guifei
Tang Emperor Xuanzong was an emperor with distinct contributions as well as errors.
On one hand, he worked hard to govern the country.
He initiated the Tang Dynasty’s peak of cultural brilliance – the Kaiyuan Golden Age
On the other hand, he lost himself in the charms of a women and showed undue favor to a treacherous court official.
This directly caused the Tang Dynasty to go from prosperity to decline.
His mistakes had to do with a woman; this woman was Yang Guifei.
The inspiring yet tragic love story between Tang Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei is still told by people to this day.
According to legend, the infatuated Tang Emperor Xuanzong was deeply in love with Yang Guifei.
No matter what she wanted, the emperor would find a way to satisfy her.
Yang Guifei loved to dress up, and always wanted new, beautiful clothes.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong thus arranged for 700 of the greatest tailors to specially make clothes for her.
Yang Guifei wanted to bathe.
So, Tang Emperor Xuanzong right away built the Huaqing Pool outside of Chang’an, ..
.. and went with her there to soak in hot springs.
Yang Guifei’s favorite fruit was lychee from the south.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong immediately dispatched someone to use the fastest horse, ..
.. crossing over mountain ridges without stopping to deliver the most fresh lychee from the south to Chang’an.
But disaster quietly began to take hold during this time.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong was focused on his romantic relationship with Yang Guifei all day.
The country’s major affairs were all handed over to Yang Guifei’s cousin Yang Guozhong to deal with.
Yang Guozhong loved money, and he also didn’t have the ability to govern the country.
A lot of people wanted to be government officials, and they would give money to Yang Guozhong.
Yang Guozhong took these people’s money, and let a lot of unqualified people become government officials.
Thus, the lives of the ordinary people became increasingly difficult.
Under these conditions, many problems arose in the country.
An Lushan and Shi Siming were two important government officials at the time, and they led 15,000 troops in rebellion.
This armed rebellion became the well-known “An-Shi Rebellion” in history.
Their excuse was that they wanted to arrest Yang Guozhong and take over the governing of the country.
This way, the country’s problems would be solved.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong heard that there was an armed rebellion among the troops, and became both angry and afraid.
He left Chang’an and fled to Sichuan, taking Yang Guifei and her family with him.
En route, something big happened.
The emperor’s soldiers believed that the reason for the country’s chaotic state was Yang Guifei and her cousin.
Now the emperor was taking them to Sichuan with him, so the country would continue to be governed by Yang Guozhong.
So, the soldiers acted together, and killed Yang Guozhong.
This wasn’t enough. The soldiers believed that the root cause of the nation’s problems was Yang Guifei.
If Yang Guifei continued to remain by the emperor’s side, the emperor wouldn’t have time to govern the country.
Thus, the soldiers requested Tang Emperor Xuanzong kill Yang Guifei, ..
.. or else they would refuse to protect the emperor in the future.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong, with tears in his eyes, personally pleaded for his lover,
“Yang Guifei is my most beloved imperial concubine; we’ve lived together for over ten years.
She’s not the same as Yang Guozhong and hasn’t done any bad deeds out there. Please spare her!”
The soldiers were very firm and did not agree.
They maintained that if Yang Guifei wasn’t killed, ..
.. then they wouldn’t be able to vent the hatred of the ordinary people throughout the world.
The pitiful Yang Guifei had began crying.
She knew that at this point even the emperor had to listen to the soldiers’ words.
Yang Guifei said to Tang Emperor Xuanzong,
“Your Majesty, for the sake of the country, I had better go and die; take care!”
In the end Yang Guifei committed suicide by hanging. She was only thirty-seven years old.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong, looking at the white cloth Yang Guifei used to hang herself, cried his heart out.
The soldiers witnessed all of this with their own eyes, and only then were willing to continue on their journey.
Very soon, they arrived in Sichuan.
In later days, Tang Emperor Xuanzong was also no longer the emperor; every day, he neither said much nor ate much.
Because he no longer had Yang Guifei, nothing was able to make him happy.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong’s time as monarch ended, and he also lost forever his beloved imperial concubine Yang Yuhuan.
Tang Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei’s poignant romance thus came to an end.
